messages:
oliver: Noticed a billing discrepancy in staging: a truncated stream + client retry ended up being counted twice. trace=txn-2026-05-04-11a7

lee: timeline? is this the resume path or a parallel toolcall?

oliver: client streamed, server truncated due to max_tokens, client reconnected. Router chose a fallback toolcall to finish the prefix. Toolcall succeeded and stream resumed. Ledger shows both the provisional prefix and the toolcall as confirmed.

anya: sounds like provisional entries arent being invalidated when a superseding confirm arrives. We only flip provisional->confirmed on clean EOF currently.

lee: quick mitigation: console should flag provisional items in the session timeline so support doesn't auto-bill them. longer fix: ledger dedupe by provenance.

oliver: proposal: extend POST /ledger/confirm with optional "supersedes" array containing provisional keys. Ledger will atomically confirm the new tokens and mark superseded provisional as consumed. Backwards compatible.

anya: also add router telemetry: emit route_event with resume_reason (values: resume, client_reconnect, fallback_toolcall) and include attribution keys array. Helps quantify frequency.

lee: tests: (1) confirm with supersedes present -> only one confirmed total, (2) supersedes missing -> confirm behaves unchanged. Add e2e replay of the truncated-then-toolcall sequence.

support: noted. we'll surface provisional badge and link to a canned reply.

billing-bot: created ticket INV-2026-77 for trace txn-2026-05-04-11a7

oliver: open question: TTL for provisional entries. propose 10m window where supersedes accepted to avoid accidental cross-session dedupe. Agreed?

anya: +1. I'll add TTL enforcement in ledger.confirm.

lee: timeline: small PR for ledger Monday, router telemetry change + console filter Tuesday, staging validation Wednesday.

oliver: thanks all. capture action items in INV-2026-77 and close once staging replay shows zero duplicates.
